summary: Plan indicators, check community project data and use feedback for decisions. Explore the five-day M&E course and review the outline.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation for community development projects connects field activities with evidence of community-level change. For M&E officers, community development practitioners and programme managers, it covers mapping results through a Theory of Change, defining and disaggregating outcome indicators, and checking baseline and field data quality. Participants also practise gathering community feedback and using findings to adapt project activities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who track community-level results, coordinate field evidence or use evaluation findings to adjust development activities.
modules: Theory of Change for Community Results
prerequisites: Working familiarity with community development project activities and basic results terminology is expected. Prior responsibility for M&E is useful but not essential.
